groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance (table 3, DMzp), as the Nearby Universe places the members Cosmicflows-4 holds, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth.

table.note: Column 4 is RC3's numerical stage of each galaxy's catalogue morphology (members.mts): E and dE -5, S0 and dS0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5, Sd 7, Sm 9, Im and BCD 10; a type left open between two classes has none. Positions are VizieR's ICRS conversion of the catalogue's B1950 positions.

sample: The Centaurus Cluster Catalogue's 198 members of class 1 (membership certain; table6), less those within 10 arcsec of a Cosmicflows-4 galaxy, which the Nearby Universe field draws already: 163 kept.
meaning: Centaurus Cluster member galaxies from the Centaurus Cluster Catalogue (Jerjen & Dressler 1997) that the Nearby Universe field does not draw, one dot each at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance, in the colour of its type. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

endsNm.basis: The Sc template's optical spectrum ends at 766 nm. Cutting the other four templates at 766 nm leaves each colour the same to the sRGB step (checked 2026-09-29), since the eye's response there is under 0.1% of its peak.

missing.label: no type
missing.basis: The D65 white point: a galaxy with no measured type is drawn without a colour.

toneBy.band: B (the catalogue's total blue magnitude BT), not corrected for extinction
toneBy.basis: The Nearby Universe field's tone scale (its galaxies' recipe), so a member is as bright as a field galaxy of the same absolute magnitude: each galaxy's absolute B magnitude (its B magnitude minus the group's distance modulus) darkens its colour, from full at M_B -21.5 to 30% at -17.5, linear in magnitude; a member without a magnitude takes the faintest tone. Galactic extinction toward the cluster is not removed.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 150 Mpc of the Sun, three times the cluster's distance, so every member shows while the cluster is selected and framed (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).

classBasis: Class bounds are the midpoints between the de Vaucouleurs numerical types the templates stand for (E -5, S0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5); types later than Sc take the Sc template, the latest in the atlas.
